notes: Component estimate, not a published Azure node/rack rating. Microsoft documents 2 Grace CPUs and 4 GB300 GPUs per VM and 130 TB/s aggregate NVLink bandwidth per 18-VM rack: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/virtual-machines/sizes/gpu-accelerated/nd-gb300-v6-series . Microsoft Table 2 publishes a 1400 W per-GPU power limit; CPU power uses the D.2 ARM <=128-core default of 300 W. Proportional shared-fabric allocation assumes identical nodes: 130/18 TB/s per node, entered in aggregate_bandwidth_tbps because the checker costs components per node and multiplies by nodes_provisioned. Across 12 nodes this allocates 130*(12/18) TB/s once; at D.1's 5 pJ/bit the scale-up term is 3466.666666666667 W. Total = (24*300 + 48*1400 + 130*(12/18)*8*5)*1.30 = 101226.66666666667 W, rounded once to 101.23 kW. Nodes communicate through NVLink only for this submission, so no separate scale-out fabric is costed. Shared-fabric proration is an explicitly disclosed allocation assumption, not a vendor-published rating or an expressly approved application of the published-rack scaling rule; reviewer acceptance remains outstanding.
